prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A bustling outdoor scene in a sunlit parking lot, filled with people casually dressed in modern, everyday clothing, many of whom are holding up their phones to take photos. The focal point is an enormous, hyper-realistic replica of a microSD card, towering over the crowd. The card is black with bold white and yellow text, reading "World's Largest MicroSD," "123CB," and "44°," with intricate gold chip detailing, mimicking the look of a real microSD card but at a monumental scale. To the right, a large roadside-style sign humorously advertises the microSD, using playful, slightly nonsensical text. The sky is clear and blue, casting bright, natural daylight that creates crisp shadows and highlights the vivid colors of the scene. The composition is wide and cinematic, with a slight depth of field that keeps the crowd and the giant microSD card in sharp focus, while the background—featuring more cars and distant trees—softly recedes. The overall mood is lively and whimsical, capturing the sense of awe and amusement among the onlookers. The image has a documentary, almost surreal quality, blending everyday realism with an absurd, larger-than-life subject.
